evidence_source: development inspection, before any A-LoRA task inference

examples.text: I need to sync product details from "https://external-source.com/products" to our local database. I want the sync to happen tonight at 11 PM, and if any error occurs, it should continue without aborting the whole process. Can you set this up?

tools.description: Synchronizes product details from an external data source to the local database. It ensures data consistency and integrity during the synchronization process.
tools.name: productDataSync.syncProductDetails

dataSource.description: The external data source URL from which product details will be fetched.

syncOptions.description: Options to customize the synchronization process, including the sync interval and error handling strategies.

errorHandling.description: Strategy to handle errors during synchronization, either 'Abort' or 'Continue'.

syncInterval.description: Time interval between successive sync operations, specified in the format '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', e.g., '2021-12-31 23:59'.

interpretation: unanchored relative-date gold can make exact argument matching underdetermined; V1 low scores cannot all be attributed to model capability
